ranking_rule: identical full ordering, ties broken by MAE then model name
mae_rule: abs(MAE_B - MAE_A) / MAE_A < 0.01 for every baseline
zero_mae_rule: if MAE_A is zero, MAE_B must also be zero
controls: same A-derived date windows, union series keys and identical eligible cells; each arm uses its own past demand and labels
arm_B: retain all rows with identical GPS cleaning and flags; count by ds, do not correct timestamps
ml_followup: Repeat the same A/B comparison after LightGBM/XGBoost are implemented; not covered by baseline conclusion
